simple.meaning: נָחַל (nâchal) appears 59 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 11 more, beginning at Exodus 23:30. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, offering, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נָחַל (H5157) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows נָחַל through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.full: H5157. nachal נָחַל verb denominative get or take as a possession (compare Gerber 236ff. ; Ecclus נחל Ecclesiasticus 45:22b +; Late Hebrew id. (rare)); — Qal Perfect ׳נ Zechariah 2:16; 2 masculine singular נָחַלְתָּ Exod 23:20 8 t. Perfect; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִנְחַלְ Isa 57:13 ; 3 masculine plural יִנְחֲלוּ Num 18:23 5 t.; יִנְחָ֑לוּ 26:55 2 t.; + 8 t. Imperfect; Infinitive נְחֹל 34:18 ; Josh 19:49 ; — 1 take possession, inherit: a. land of Canaan , Exod 23:30 (E), 32:13 (J), Isa 57:13 ; Ezek 47:14 ; Zoin and Judah Psalm 69:37. b. special sections in the land, of tribes and individuals , נחלה נחל Josh 17:6 (J); נ אשׁר ׳נחלה Deut 19:14 (D), Num 35:8 (P), compare Josh 14:1 (P); without accusative, have or get a (landed) property , Num 18:20 , 23 , 24 ; 26:55 ; 32:19 ; Josh 16:4 ; 19:9 (all P), Judg 11:3 . c. land of Moab and Ammon by conquest Zeph 2:9 ; landed property הנוים בכל Psa 82:8 . d. God takes possession of Israel as his private property Exod 34:9 (J); Judah Zechariah 2:16. 2 figurative have or get as a possession, property: testimonies Psa 119:111 , glory Prov 3:35 , good things 28:10 , lies Jer 16:19 , wind Prov 11:29 , simplicity 14:18 . 3 divide the land for a possession , Num 34:17-18 , Josh 19:49 (all P; incorrect pointing for Piel, so SS). Pi`el divide for a possession: Perfect 3masculine singular נִחַל Josh 13:32 ; 3 plural נִחֲלוּ 14:1 ; 19:51 ; Infinitive נַחֵל Num 34:29 (all P); also 34:17-18 , Josh 19:49 (see Qal 3 ). Hithpa`el Perfect 3plural suffix הִתְנַחֲלוּם Isa 24:2 ; 2 masculine plural הִתְנַחַלְתֶּם Lev 25:46 ; Num 33:54 ; Imperfect תִּתְנַחֲלוּ 34:13 ; Ezek 47:13 ; תִּתְנֶחָ֑לוּ Num 33:54 ; Infinitive הִתְנַחֵל 32:18 ; possess oneself of land (accusative), 33:54 ; 34:13 (P) Ezek 47:13 ; נחלה Num 32:18 (P); slaves Lev 25:46 (P) Isa 14:2 ; absolute, reference to land Num 33:54 (P); all with לְ person (for whose benefit), except 32:18 ; 34:13 ; Isa 14:2 . Hiph`il Perfect 1singular הִנְחַ֫לְתִּי Jer 3:18 3 t. Perfect; Imperfect 3masculine singular יַנְחִיל Deut 3:28 ; יַנְחִל Ezek 46:18 ; 2 masculine singular suffix תַּנְחִילֶנָּה Deut 31:7 5 t. Imperfect; Infinitive construct הַנְחִיל Isa 49:8 ; Prov 8:21 ; בְּהַנְחֵל Deut 32:8 (on form compare Ew § 238 d Kö i. 315 Ges § 53k ; read בְּהַנְחִל ?); suffix הַנְחִילוֺ 21:16 ; Participle מַנְחִיל 12:10 ; — 1 give as a possession: a. land of Canaan (given by ׳י or his servants), accusative of person and thing, Deut 1:38 ; 3:28 ; 12:10 ; 19:3 ; 31:7 ; Josh 1:6 (all D), Jer 3:18 ; 12:14 . b. various things, accusative of person and thing, especially blessings , Zech 8:12 ; 1Sam 2:8 ; Prov 8:21 ; accusative of thing Isa 49:8 ; accusative of person Deut 32:8 . 2 cause to inherit, give as an inheritance , with accusative of person and thing, Deut 21:16 ; accusative of person + מן thing, Ezek 46:18 ; accusative of person Prov 13:22 ; ל person 1Chr 28:8 . Hoph`al Perfect 1singular הָנְחַלְתּי Job 7:3 made to possess, with accusative of thing, e.g. months of vanity.
